execution.description: Added the first lessons entry from a branch other than the pipeline's own, then re-rendered the pipeline view, because tests/cpu/test_challenge_pipeline.py fails while the view is stale.

expected: Appending a lessons entry touches only carbon/challenge_pipeline/lessons/, so parallel branches never conflict (lessons.py: one file per entry).
observed: The committed view docs/development/CHALLENGE_PIPELINE.md prints the count of entries by status, so every new entry forces a regeneration of that file. Two branches that each add a lesson then conflict in the view, which defeats the one-file-per-entry design.
keep: Regenerate the view with its renderer; never edit it by hand.
change: Keep counts that change with every execution out of the committed view.

proposed_revision.text: The committed pipeline view lists only lessons awaiting a decision (PROPOSED) and links to carbon/challenge_pipeline/lessons/ for the rest, without a count. Adding a RECORDED entry then changes no committed file but the entry itself, and parallel branches no longer conflict in the view.
